ONE 1024x1024 square image containing EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows of 16 separate small pixel-art illustrations. All canvas background and gutters must be flat pure magenta #FF00FF. Equal-sized square cells, with 24px clear magenta gutters at x=256,512,768 and y=256,512,768, magenta outer margin. Exactly one simple isolated icon-like subject per cell. Keep each icon INSIDE central 70% of cell WIDTH and central 55% of cell HEIGHT, wide 4:3 silhouette, so the icon survives a 32x32 to 32x24 centre crop. No connecting objects across cells. Row 1 left to right: heavy sword making a broad slash; raised shield; boot kicking; thrown dagger. Row 2 left to right: green sprouting seed; curved vine whip; skull with spores; thorned heart. Row 3 left to right: hourglass; comet; clock face without numbers; crystal lens. Row 4 left to right: potion flask; gold coin stack; spiral vortex; burning ember. Authentic Phantasy Star Sega Master System 1987 style, strict 8-bit flat colours, each icon drawn as if 28x20 pixels with large square pixels upscaled nearest neighbour. Thick black 1 pixel outline, tiny limited palette of saturated blues, cyans, greens, purple, bronze, gold, warm orange, white and black, RGB channels only 00/55/AA/FF. Very simple readable chunky shapes, two hard tones per material, no gradient, anti-aliasing, blur, fine details, decorative borders, text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark. Magenta only for empty background, never on objects.
